summary_en: This study tests CD33 FPBMC, which are fresh immune cells armed with an anti-CD3 x anti-CD33 bispecific antibody, in adults with acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome who still have measurable residual disease. Participants receive 4 weekly intravenous infusions, followed by 4-6 weeks of a hypomethylating agent with or without venetoclax, and one such cycle may be repeated up to 4 times. The record does not list a primary outcome measure; it describes the study as a Phase 1 study to understand safety and estimate efficacy.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa las CD33 FPBMC, que son células mononucleares de sangre periférica frescas armadas con un anticuerpo biespecífico anti-CD3 x anti-CD33, en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda o síndrome mielodisplásico que aún tienen enfermedad residual medible. Los participantes reciben 4 infusiones intravenosas semanales, seguidas de 4 a 6 semanas de un agente hipometilante con o sin venetoclax, y este ciclo puede repetirse hasta 4 veces. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; describe el estudio como una fase 1 para conocer la seguridad y estimar la eficacia.
who_for: Newly diagnosed or relapsed/refractory AML after intensive chemotherapy or at least 2 cycles of non-intensive treatment.
Relapsed/refractory MDS or MDS/MPN overlap after specified prior hypomethylating agent treatment.
Persistent or recurrent measurable residual disease with residual blasts that are CD33 positive.
LVEF at least 45% at rest and performance status of 2 or less.
not_for: Significant liver, kidney or immune dysfunction, or uncontrolled serious infection, as defined in the criteria.
Known HIV with detectable viral load, hepatitis B surface antigen positive, or known or suspected active hepatitis C.
